flight_decks.logistics: recovery: overtake from astern into the AFT mouth, settle on the aft station (WS 010/011 launch points), recovery barrier at X -12 against overruns -> lane: tow dolly onto the aft traverser -> traverser: sideways, nose forward, to transfer door 1 -> door: into its lock across the transfer gallery (outer door closes, lock cycles) -> gallery: inner door into the central hold in the ventral keel/torso at the same deck height -> central hold: refit (rearm, refuel, repair) -> forward through the hold to door 3 -> traverser out to the forward station (WS 012/013), deflectors up -> launch out of the FORWARD mouth. Door 2 amidships is the crash and spares door (barrier catches, gantry-crane lifts). In-game the aft slots also launch aft through the aft mouth; the lane is fly-through when barrier and deflectors are stowed (their rest state).

anhedral.note: the arm above (deck, armour, wells, turrets) slopes down outboard; the hangar under it is level: floor, launch points, mouths, doors and gallery heights are final as given. Arm deck at the outboard lane wall is z -4.46.
